climate: Cabernet Sauvignon sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.
Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A region in the South West Australia area of Western Australia, with about 1,950 acres of vines and a mixed set of grapes: Shiraz 21 percent, Sauvignon Blanc 19, Chardonnay 17, Cabernet Sauvignon 13 and Semillon 11.
